_doc: Baseline SHA-256 hashes for tracked patch files; updated by patch_sources.py --update-baseline. Schema: { sources: { <name>: { <path>: { sha256, verdict, note } } } }. Verdicts: absorb-now | verify-then-absorb | defer | not-applicable | unreviewed.

patches/emacs-31/fix-ns-x-colors.patch.note: Refreshes x-colors at NS window-system-initialization; not upstream as of 2026-05-20; confirm headless dump truncates ns-list-colors before landing. See fork-homebrew-emacs-plus.md.

patches/emacs-31/round-undecorated-frame.note: Adds undecorated-round frame parameter; not in upstream or this fork (grep src/ for Qundecorated_round).

patches/emacs-31/system-appearance.patch.note: Adds ns-system-appearance + change hook; most-requested macOS feature; not in upstream or this fork.

editors/emacs/files/patch-Info.plist.in..note: MacPorts LSEnvironment PATH injection into app bundle plist; useful pattern but the value is MacPorts-specific.

editors/emacs/files/patch-allow-powerpc..note: Targets configure.ac (removed at 313f867 Meson cutover); PowerPC Darwin not a fork target.

editors/emacs/files/patch-src_dbusbind.c.note: Disables dbus no-autolaunch guard for MacPorts launchd-managed dbus; jotain disables dbus on Darwin anyway.

editors/emacs/files/patch-tree-sitter-0..note: Renames :eq?/:match?/:pred? back to older spellings; fork already uses new names in doc/lispref/parsing.texi.

aqua/emacs-mac-app/files/emacs-mac-app-d.note: Multi-tty patch targeting the Yamamoto Mac port (HAVE_MACGUI); not portable to NS port.

aqua/emacs-mac-app/files/emacs-mac-app-m.note: Stable-branch counterpart of devel-multi-tty; same Mac-port assumptions.

aqua/emacs-mac-app/files/patch-src_emacs.note: Runtime __PREFIX__/bin PATH injection for imaxima; MacPorts-specific.

overlays/patches-31/round-undecorated-fr.note: Re-host of emacs-plus round-undecorated-frame; see homebrew-emacs-plus row of same name.

overlays/patches-31/system-appearance.pa.note: Re-host of emacs-plus system-appearance; same SHA, see homebrew-emacs-plus row.
